supersedes_note: Version 2 governs the W3 board only. The W2 rubric is not edited, not moved and not relocked; tools/verify.mjs recomputes its digest against its own lock on every run and fails if those bytes have changed.

ordering_evidence.method: authoring order, observed live in the session that produced both files
ordering_evidence.observed: rubric.v2.md and registry.json were written before the first W3 candidate existed; the first render in renders/ was produced afterwards, in the same session
ordering_evidence.limitation: modification time does not survive a fresh Git checkout, so the ordering cannot be re-observed later from the files alone. This lock is what replaces it: the rubric bytes are pinned by digest, and every render is produced against exactly these bytes.
ordering_evidence.honest_scope: This records that the ordering was observed once, by the author, in the session that created both files. It is not independent corroboration, and a reader who was not present should treat it as the author's account.

rule: tools/verify.mjs recomputes the digest of rubric.v2.md on every run and fails if it differs. Changing a gate means adding a new versioned rubric and a new lock, never editing these bytes in place.
